description: This file defines a PHP class Image_Graph_Marker_Pinpoint that extends another class Image_Graph_Marker_Icon. It creates a marker object represented by a pinpoint icon for use in a graph rendering library. The class includes a constructor that sets the icon image and specifies point coordinates.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pinpoint
classes.description: A class representing a pinpoint marker icon for graph annotations, extending Image_Graph_Marker_Icon.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Pinpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the marker with a specific icon image and sets point coordinates.
